definitions.accepted: The Email Service API accepted the send request and returned a messageId.

definitions.qualified: A delivered inquiry was manually assigned the Gmail label Metatecno/Qualified by sales.
definitions.formErrorRate: form_error events divided by form_start events; error events contain only an error code.
definitions.deliveryRate: delivered leads divided by accepted leads.
